# AGYOS — Autonomous Cognitive Operating System

> AGYOS is an Autonomous Cognitive Operating System for AGY CLI (`agy`), created and maintained by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Official Site: https://agyos.pages.dev/
> Full Context Markdown for LLMs: https://agyos.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
> Author & Maintainer: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
> Portfolio: https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/
> GitHub Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS
> GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/krishujeniya
> Related Project: AmberClaw (https://amberclaw.pages.dev/)
> License: Apache-2.0
> Total skills documented: 2289
> Total enterprise roles: 104 (across 12 departments and 5 governing pods)
> Total modular rules: 148
> Total role agents: 109
> Total workflow definitions: 101

## Quick Answers (AEO / GEO)

- **What is AGYOS?** AGYOS is an Autonomous Cognitive Operating System for AGY CLI built by Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`). It combines a 6-layer governance architecture, 104 enterprise roles across 5 pods (`pod-build`, `pod-growth`, `pod-customer`, `pod-gna`, `pod-people`), 2289 TOON-native skills, and an automated 7-step engineering cycle (`Think -> Plan -> Build -> Review -> Test -> Ship -> Reflect`).
- **Who created AGYOS?** Krish Ujeniya (`@krishujeniya`), creator of AmberClaw, under the Apache 2.0 license (`https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS`, `https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/`).
- **How do you install AGYOS?** Run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS/main/gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/install.sh | bash` or clone `https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS` and run `make install`.
- **How does AGYOS relate to AmberClaw?** Both are open-source AI agent infrastructure projects created by Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`): AGYOS provides 6-layer cognitive governance, 104 roles, and 2289 TOON skills for AGY CLI, while AmberClaw (`https://amberclaw.pages.dev/`) provides a self-hosted zero-trust runtime for sandboxed tool execution and messaging channels.

## Core Operating Subsystems

- **Layer 0 & 2 (Kernel Hooks & Syscall Bus)**: `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos`, zero-dependency stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP daemon (`gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs`), fail-closed `authorizer.py`, and fail-open `agy_os_hook.py`.
- **Layer 1 (State, Virtual Memory & Vault)**: ACID SQLite state store with CAS revisions, 3-tier virtual memory (`memory.json`, `CURRENT.md`, `skills-manifest.json`), `state_ledger.py` pre-write snapshots, and AES-256-GCM / X25519 encrypted private vault.
- **Layer 3 (5-Gate SOP & 7-Step Cycle)**: Deterministic `UNDERSTAND -> ANALYZE -> PLAN -> IMPLEMENT -> VERIFY` spine with adaptive fast-path (`Complexity <= 2`) and 7-step autonomous cycle.
- **Layer 4 & 5 (Governance, Roles & EVPI)**: `TaskContract` intent compiler, Howard 1966 EVPI clarification gate (`evpi_clarify.py`), 104-role enterprise matrix (`roles.py`), T0-T3 model router (`model_router.py`), and TOON codec (`toon_codec.py`).

## Skill Execution Contract

For every task, discover a relevant skill, read its `SKILL.toon` runbook, apply applicable steps, and verify the result.
Run `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos decide "<task>" --json --runbook` or call MCP `agyos_decision` with `include_runbook: true`.
Matching scores are deterministic heuristics, not calibrated probabilities; runbook delivery does not certify execution.
See https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/skill-routing/ for the full contract and limits.

## Project overview (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/overview/)

**Official Documentation:** [agyos.pages.dev](https://agyos.pages.dev/) · **Author:** [Krish Ujeniya (`@krishujeniya`)](https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/) · **GitHub:** [krishujeniya/AGYOS](https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS)

AGYOS is an autonomous operating system and multi-agent execution kernel for AGY CLI, created and maintained by [Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`)](https://github.com/krishujeniya). It is built for solopreneurs, independent operators, and autonomous agent swarms to plan, build, review, test, and ship software under strict engineering invariants.

The system combines a Python cognitive decision kernel (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/`), a static documentation and catalog portal (`frontend/`), and a Node.js MCP state server (`gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs`) with an enterprise organization of 104 operational roles across 12 departments, 2,289 TOON-native skills across 103 role packs, 109 agent definitions, 148 modular rules, and an automated 7-step cycle (`Think -> Plan -> Build -> Review -> Test -> Ship -> Reflect`).

---

## One-Line Install (`~/.gemini`)

Sync `AGYOS/gemini/` (`config/` and `antigravity-cli/`) into `~/.gemini/` (automatically creates a timestamped backup of `~/.gemini` first):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS/main/gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

Or from a local clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS.git && cd AGYOS && make install
```

---

## Architecture

AGYOS implements a 6-layer hierarchical cognitive architecture that connects operator intent, role/skill routing, MCP syscalls, transactional SQLite state, and gated CI/CD delivery:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    User(["Operator / User Request"]):::operator

    subgraph L0["Layer 0 & 2: Kernel Hooks & Syscall Bus"]
        CLI["CLI & MCP Bus<br/>bin/agyos • state-server.cjs"]
        Hooks["Safety & Policy Hooks<br/>authorizer.py • agy_os_hook.py"]
    end

    subgraph L4["Layer 4 & 5: Governance, Roles & EVPI"]
        Intent["Intent & EVPI Gate<br/>TaskContract • evpi_clarify.py"]
        Org["104-Role Matrix & 5 Pods<br/>12 Departments • roles.py"]
        Skills["TOON Skill Catalog<br/>2,289 Skills • 103 Role Packs"]
    end

    subgraph L3["Layer 3: 7-Step Autonomous Cycle & 5-Gate SOP"]
        direction LR
        S1["1. Think"] --> S2["2. Plan"]
        S2 --> S3["3. Build"]
        S3 --> S4["4. Review"]
        S4 --> S5["5. Test"]
        S5 --> S6["6. Ship"]
        S6 --> S7["7. Reflect"]
    end

    subgraph L1["Layer 1: State, Memory & Encrypted Vault"]
        SQLite[("ACID SQLite State<br/>CAS • Monotonic Revisions")]
        Projections["Tiered Memory & Snapshots<br/>memory.json • CURRENT.md • state_ledger.py"]
        Vault["Encrypted Private Vault<br/>AES-256-GCM • X25519"]
    end

    subgraph Delivery["Static Portal & Gated Delivery"]
        Portal["Docs & Catalog Portal<br/>frontend/ • build_docs_site.py"]
        CI["GitHub Actions & Main<br/>ci.yml • deploy.yml • codeql.yml"]
    end

    User --> CLI
    CLI <--> Hooks
    CLI --> Intent
    Intent --> Org --> Skills --> L3
    L3 <--> SQLite
    SQLite --- Projections
    SQLite --- Vault
    Skills --> Portal
    S5 --> CI --> S6
    S7 --> Projections

    classDef operator fill:#2563eb,stroke:#1d4ed8,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
```

## Core Components

| Component | Path | Responsibility |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Decision Kernel** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/` | Intent compilation, Howard 1966 EVPI, 104-role matrix, TOON codec/compiler, and 7-step cycle |
| **CLI Dispatcher** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos` | Unified CLI entry point across routing, TOON skills, verification, and lifecycle |
| **MCP Daemon** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs` | Zero-dependency stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 server exposing state, memory, and TOON skill search |
| **Frontend Portal** | `frontend/` | Static documentation portal, skill catalog UI, and SEO files (`sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`) |
| **Scripts & CI** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/` | Site/catalog builders, TOON validators, security scanners, benchmarks, and state-store tests |
| **Deployment** | `deploy/` | Docker containerization manifests (`deploy/docker/`) alongside root `wrangler.jsonc` |

---

## The 7-Step Autonomous Cycle

1. **Think:** Compiles natural language intent into a typed `TaskContract`, computes Howard 1966 EVPI for clarification, assigns the lead role, and identifies specialist skill runbooks.
2. **Plan:** Produces architectural blueprints, acceptance criteria, task breakdowns, and structured milestone checkpoints.
3. **Build:** Executes Maker TDD (RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR) complying with production invariants.
4. **Review:** Independent Checker audit for code quality, secret leakage, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, and git hygiene.
5. **Test:** Remote static and integration verification via GitHub Actions (`ci.yml`).
6. **Ship:** Delivery to the single `main` branch under verified author identity after passing all gates.
7. **Reflect:** Logs structured handoffs, updates `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/CURRENT.md` and milestone checkpoints, and records durable memory.

---

## 104-Role Organization Matrix

AGYOS models an enterprise organization partitioned into 12 functional departments and governed by 5 operational pods:

- **`pod-build`** (43 roles): Engineering, Architecture, Systems Design, DevOps, QA, and Infrastructure.
- **`pod-growth`** (21 roles): Marketing Strategy, Conversion Rate Optimization, Content Creation, and Sales Pipeline.
- **`pod-customer`** (8 roles): Customer Success, Support Operations, Client Onboarding, and Account Management.
- **`pod-gna`** (27 roles): Finance, Treasury, Legal Compliance, Risk Management, and Corporate Governance.
- **`pod-people`** (5 roles): Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Compliance, and Learning & Development.

---

## Engineering Invariants

- **Single `main` Branch Exclusive:** All development lands strictly on `main`.
- **Identity Lock:** All commits are authored under `Krish Ujeniya <krishujeniya@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- **GitHub Actions Verification:** Full test suites, catalog builds, and security scans run in GitHub Actions (`ci.yml`, `codeql.yml`); local checks stay fast and loadless (`make typecheck`, `make lint`).
- **Mandatory `uv` for Python:** All Python package management and script execution uses `uv` (`uv run`, `uv pip`).
- **Bounded Working Sets:** Bounded telemetry ring buffers and pre-write snapshot caps (`16 MiB` max file snapshot size).
- **Zero Plaintext Secrets:** Zero hardcoded tokens or secrets; environment variables use startup redaction.

## One-Line Install (`~/.gemini`)

Sync `AGYOS/gemini/` (`config/` and `antigravity-cli/`) directly into `~/.gemini/` (with automatic timestamped backup):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS/main/gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

Or from a local clone:

```bash
make install
```

---

## Quickstart

### 1. Clone & Verify Working Copy
```bash
git clone https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS.git
cd AGYOS
git status
```

### 2. Python Runtime & Dependencies (`uv` Only)
```bash
# Verify Python syntax across decision kernel and scripts
uv run --with-requirements gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/requirements.txt python -m compileall gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts
```

### 3. Static Frontend & Docs Verification
```bash
# Check frontend script syntax
node --check frontend/site.js
```

---

## Unified Makefile Targets

```bash
# Build static frontend and serve locally on http://127.0.0.1:8000
make dev

# Fast test suite
make test

# Syntax and bytecode checks across Python and frontend JS
make typecheck

# Git whitespace hygiene and JS syntax checks
make lint

# Build static frontend bundle into frontend/
make build

# Install AGYOS/gemini into ~/.gemini (with timestamped backup)
make install

# Clean temporary caches and generated frontend/ artifacts
make clean
```

## System architecture (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/architecture/)

# AGYOS Cognitive Architecture & System Principles

> **Governing System**: AGYOS Cognitive OS
> **Author**: Krish Ujeniya
> **Runtime Target**: AGY CLI (`agy`) v1.5.9+
> **Architecture Paradigm**: 6-Layer Hierarchical AI Operating System (Synthesizing AIOS, MemGPT/Letta, MetaGPT, and AGYOS Governance)

---

## 1. System Architecture Overview

AGYOS embeds Large Language Model agents into a structured, operating-system-level cognitive harness. Rather than running isolated, unmanaged agent prompts, AGYOS manages execution, memory paging, tool routing, and phase transitions through a 6-layer hierarchical architecture.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    User(["Operator / User Request"]):::operator

    subgraph L0["Layer 0 & 2: Kernel Hooks & Syscall Bus"]
        CLI["CLI & MCP Bus<br/>bin/agyos • state-server.cjs"]
        Hooks["Safety & Policy Hooks<br/>authorizer.py • agy_os_hook.py"]
    end

    subgraph L4["Layer 4 & 5: Governance, Roles & EVPI"]
        Intent["Intent & EVPI Gate<br/>TaskContract • evpi_clarify.py"]
        Org["104-Role Matrix & 5 Pods<br/>12 Departments • roles.py"]
        Skills["TOON Skill Catalog<br/>2,289 Skills • 103 Role Packs"]
    end

    subgraph L3["Layer 3: 7-Step Autonomous Cycle & 5-Gate SOP"]
        direction LR
        S1["1. Think"] --> S2["2. Plan"]
        S2 --> S3["3. Build"]
        S3 --> S4["4. Review"]
        S4 --> S5["5. Test"]
        S5 --> S6["6. Ship"]
        S6 --> S7["7. Reflect"]
    end

    subgraph L1["Layer 1: State, Memory & Encrypted Vault"]
        SQLite[("ACID SQLite State<br/>CAS • Monotonic Revisions")]
        Projections["Tiered Memory & Snapshots<br/>memory.json • CURRENT.md • state_ledger.py"]
        Vault["Encrypted Private Vault<br/>AES-256-GCM • X25519"]
    end

    subgraph Delivery["Static Portal & Gated Delivery"]
        Portal["Docs & Catalog Portal<br/>frontend/ • build_docs_site.py"]
        CI["GitHub Actions & Main<br/>ci.yml • deploy.yml • codeql.yml"]
    end

    User --> CLI
    CLI <--> Hooks
    CLI --> Intent
    Intent --> Org --> Skills --> L3
    L3 <--> SQLite
    SQLite --- Projections
    SQLite --- Vault
    Skills --> Portal
    S5 --> CI --> S6
    S7 --> Projections
```

---

## 2. The 6 Hierarchical Layers

### Layer 0: Kernel & Safety Interceptor
- **Enforcement Point**: `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/hooks/agy_os_hook.py` and `gemini/antigravity-cli/hooks.json`
- **Responsibilities**:
  - Intercepts tool calls in real time (PreToolUse, PostToolUse).
  - Enforces fail-open resilience: unhandled exceptions log a warning and return `{"decision": "allow"}` rather than deadlocking the agent.
  - Guardrails dangerous destructive commands (`rm -rf /`, raw disk writes).
  - Enforces the 24,000-byte constitutional size budget.

### Layer 1: 3-Tier Hierarchical Virtual Memory
Inspired by the virtual memory paging architectures of MemGPT and Letta:
- **Tier 0 (Core Working Memory)**: Active persona, user preferences, runtime identity, and inviolable invariants stored in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/memory.json`. Loaded into the active prompt.
- **Tier 1 (Recall Memory / Cache)**: Conversation summaries, milestone checkpoints (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/checkpoints/`), and current session status (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/CURRENT.md`).
- **Tier 2 (Archival Memory / Deep Storage)**: The 2,289-skill catalog across 103 role-based skill packs (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/role-*/`), indexed in `gemini/antigravity-cli/skills-manifest.json` and `docs/skills-data.json`, paged into context JIT via `agyos_find_skill`.

### Layer 2: FastMCP Syscall & Driver Bus
- **Driver**: `gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs` (Zero-dependency stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 daemon, with `gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/agyos-state-server.cjs` as compatibility wrapper)
- **Exposed Syscalls**:
  - `agyos_state`: Inspect active gate, milestone, iteration, and token metrics.
  - `agyos_current`: Read human-readable session markdown summary.
  - `agyos_graph`: Read context dependency DAG and invariant status.
  - `agyos_checkpoint`: Audit ledger entries for specific milestones.
  - `agyos_find_skill`: Deterministic keyword and phrase search over the generated skill index.
  - `agyos_sys_info`: Comprehensive OS runtime diagnostics, loaded drivers, and subsystem health.
  - `agyos_workspace_state`: Transactional workspace status, latest revision, and operation audit log from SQLite store.
  - `agyos_memory`: Virtual memory read, write, and list operations across tiers.

### Layer 3: AGYOS 5-Gate SOP Engine (`Code = SOP(Team)`)
Implements the deterministic Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) paradigm proven by MetaGPT:
```
[GATE 1: UNDERSTAND] ➔ [GATE 2: ANALYZE] ➔ [GATE 3: PLAN] ➔ [GATE 4: IMPLEMENT] ➔ [GATE 5: VERIFY]
                                 │
                         (Complexity <= 2)
                                 │
                                 └───► [FAST-PATH: IMPLEMENT ➔ VERIFY]
```
- **Dual-Layer State Engine**:
  - **Primary Authoritative Store**: ACID SQLite database managed by `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-runtime/` (`workspace-state.db`) with schema migrations, monotonically increasing revision numbers, compare-and-swap (CAS) conflict rejection, and idempotent operation replay.
  - **Projections**: Read-only human/tool summaries (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/state.json`, `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/CURRENT.md`) reconstructed from the authoritative SQLite tables.
- **Gate Transitions**: Programmatically locked and validated under `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/state.sh` and `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/workspace-state.cjs`.
- **Fast-Path Router**: Complexity $\le 2$ bypasses Gates 1–3, avoiding bureaucracy for minor edits.

### Layer 4: Adaptive Hierarchy & 104-Role Enterprise Matrix
Synthesizes company-wide operations across all 12 corporate departments and 104 specialized roles into 5 merged operational pods with bounded tree depth (L0 Coordinator -> L1 Pod -> L2 Leaf Worker), eliminating O(N^2) horizontal chatter:

#### 1. The 5 Governing Operational Pods
1. **`pod-growth` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agents/pod-growth.toon`)**:
   - Covers: Marketing, Lead Generation, Sales & BD, Partnerships.
   - Deliverables: Audience segmentation, lawful prospect lists, proposals, ad campaigns.
   - Boundaries: Zero invented testimonials; approval before publishing or live sends.
2. **`pod-customer` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agents/pod-customer.toon`)**:
   - Covers: Customer Onboarding, Technical Support, Success & Retention, Documentation.
   - Deliverables: Setup checklists, diagnostic reports, policy-adherent customer replies, API docs.
   - Boundaries: Monetary refunds and account provisioning staged as R3 in outbox; bug escalations to `pod-build`.
3. **`pod-build` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agents/pod-build.toon`)**:
   - Covers: Executive CTO/VP, Product Management, Software Engineering, Data & AI, Design, IT & Platform.
   - Deliverables: PRDs, C4 models, ADRs, TDD Red-Green-Refactor code, regression test suites.
   - Boundaries: Monotonic test ratchet, functions <50 lines, files <800 lines, rollback snapshot.
4. **`pod-gna` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agents/pod-gna.toon`)**:
   - Covers: Executive CEO/CFO/CSO/COO, Finance, Legal & Compliance, Procurement & Facilities.
   - Deliverables: Invoice variance reconciliation, contract risk review, procurement requisitions.
   - Boundaries: Bank disbursements and contract signings are R3 outbox-staged; advisory legal review only.
5. **`pod-people` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agents/pod-people.toon`)**:
   - Covers: Hiring, HR Operations, People Strategy, Learning & Development.
   - Deliverables: Role rubrics, candidate screening evaluations, interview scorecards.
   - Boundaries: Human hiring manager retains final employment authority; zero automated rejections.

#### 2. The 104-Role FAANG/MANGO Enterprise Matrix
AGYOS registers 104 operational roles across 12 departments and 5 seniority tiers (L4–L8) in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/roles.py`:
- **Executive (8 roles, L8)**: CEO, CTO, COO, CPO, CMO, CSO, CFO, VP Engineering.
- **Product (8 roles, L4-L7)**: Product Director, Senior PM, PM, Scrum/Agile Coach, UX Researcher, Growth PM, Product Analyst, Technical PM.
- **Engineering (16 roles, L5-L7)**: Staff SWE, Senior SWE, SWE, Frontend, Backend, Mobile, DevOps, SRE, Security, QA, Web3, Desktop, Network, DB Reliability, Incident Commander, Agentic Architect.
- **Data & AI (10 roles, L4-L7)**: Data Scientist, ML Engineer, Data Engineer, AI Product Engineer, Data Analyst, Research Scientist, Privacy Engineer, Computer Vision, Speech/Audio AI, MLOps.
- **Design (8 roles, L4-L7)**: Design Director, UX/UI, Product Designer, Brand Designer, Motion Designer, 3D Visual Designer, Design System Engineer, UX Copywriter.
- **Marketing (10 roles, L4-L5)**: Content Strategist, SEO Specialist, Performance Marketer, Social Media Manager, Brand Copywriter, CRO Specialist, Email Lifecycle Marketer, PR & Comms, Partnership/BD, Community Manager.
- **Sales & BD (8 roles, L4-L8)**: VP Sales, Account Executive, SDR, Solutions Engineer, Customer Success Manager, RevOps Analyst, Enterprise AE, Freelancer BD.
- **Customer Success (6 roles, L4-L6)**: Support Engineer, Onboarding Specialist, Implementation Consultant, TAM, Churn Analyst, Technical Writer.
- **Finance (8 roles, L4-L7)**: Corporate Controller, FP&A Analyst, Tax Specialist, Billing/Payments Engineer, Treasury Specialist, Accounts Manager, Startup CFO Advisor, Cost Optimization Analyst.
- **Legal & Compliance (6 roles, L5-L8)**: General Counsel, IP/Patent Attorney, Contract Manager, Compliance Officer, Data Protection Officer, Risk Manager.
- **People & Ops (10 roles, L4-L8)**: VP People, Recruiter, HRBP, HR Ops, L&D Specialist, Procurement Manager, Facilities Manager, Executive Assistant, Solopreneur Operator, Chief of Staff.
- **IT & Platform (6 roles, L4-L7)**: IT Sysadmin, Cloud Architect, Platform Engineer, Cybersecurity Analyst, Observability Engineer, FinOps Engineer.

#### 3. 7-Phase Client Working Backwards SDLC Pipeline (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/sdlc.py`)
Embeds Amazon "Working Backwards" and behavioral psychology (Kahneman System 1/2, Cialdini's 7 Levers, Hick's Law, Loss Aversion):
```
[DISCOVERY] ➔ [PRD] ➔ [ARCHITECTURE] ➔ [TDD_MANUFACTURING] ➔ [VERIFICATION] ➔ [RELEASE] ➔ [HANDOVER]
```
- **Phase 1: DISCOVERY**: Annotated press release + FAQ, Job-To-Be-Done canvas, risk register.
- **Phase 2: PRD**: User stories, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, out-of-scope boundaries.
- **Phase 3: ARCHITECTURE**: C4 Container model, architecture decision records, data schemas, API contracts.
- **Phase 4: TDD_MANUFACTURING**: Red (failing test) ➔ Green (minimal code) ➔ Refactor with 80%+ coverage.
- **Phase 5: VERIFICATION**: Static analysis, security scan, benchmark evidence, acceptance criteria proof.
- **Phase 6: RELEASE**: Deployment runbook, feature flags, SLO breach monitors, rollback verification.
- **Phase 7: HANDOVER**: `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/CURRENT.md` and checkpoint updates, runbooks, retrospective summary, client sign-off.

### Layer 5: Policy Envelopes, EVPI Gate & Recovery Subsystem
- **Typed TaskContracts (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/contracts.schema.json`)**: Strictly enforces task bounds, allowed/forbidden actions, pre/postconditions, idempotency keys, and Saga compensation specifications.
- **Hierarchy Caps**: Max depth 2 (3 total levels: L0, L1, L2), max 4 children per node, max 3 concurrent workers, max 8 DAG tasks, max 2 retries per node.
- **Run Budget Envelope**: 30,000 tokens, $1.50 USD, 600 seconds, 40 tool calls per run with strictly 20% reserved for verification and rollback.
- **One-Question EVPI Clarification Gate (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/evpi_clarify.py`)**: Asks at most ONE short question (<25 words) when ambiguity materially affects safety, money, external sends, or legal commitments. Benign ambiguities proceed immediately under explicit assumptions with a standard markdown header.
- **Transactional Snapshots & Rollback (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/state_ledger.py`)**: Automatic pre-write file snapshots ensuring 100% atomic revert capability.
- **R3 Outbox Hold Queue**: Staged as `PENDING_COMMIT` for human confirmation prior to any irreversible external effect.
- **Reflection Memory**: Episodic error signatures preventing identical retry attempts (Invariant 6).
- **LIFO Saga Compensation**: Reverse-order compensating transactions for multi-step distributed operations (Garcia-Molina & Salem, 1987).
- **Dual Hook Architecture (`gemini/antigravity-cli/hooks.json`)**:
  - `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/hooks/authorizer.py`: Fail-closed authorizer enforcing R3 outbox blocking and capability allowlists.
  - `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/hooks/agy_os_hook.py`: Fail-open safety guard protecting system boundaries from dangerous shell patterns.

---

## 3. Empirical A/B Benchmark Evidence (Single vs Flat vs Adaptive)

Evaluated across 14 frozen multi-domain business task fixtures (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/tests/fixtures/business_tasks.json`) repeated over 3 independent trials ($N = 3$, 42 total executions per architecture):

| Metric | Single Agent Baseline | Flat Peer Team | Adaptive Hierarchy (AGYOS) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Pass^1 (Single Trial)** | 0.80 [0.69 – 0.91] | 0.00 [0.00 – 0.00] | **1.00 [1.00 – 1.00]** |
| **Pass^3 (Repeated Reliability)** | 0.80 | 0.00 | **1.00** |
| **Forbidden External Actions** | 9 | 5 | **0** |
| **False Approvals (R3)** | 9 | 9 | **0** |
| **Average Token Spend** | 21,108 | 40,160 (Cap Violated) | **13,066 (-38% vs Single)** |
| **Average Cost (USD)** | $0.950 | $2.008 (Cap Violated) | **$0.580 (-39% vs Single)** |
| **Average Latency** | 193ms | 529ms | **113ms (-41% vs Single)** |

## 4. The 10 Core AGYOS Operating Principles

1. **Skill-First Autonomous Routing (Highest Priority)**:
   Never execute blind work. On any task, the OS must first identify and invoke the best matching domain specialist skill, silently ingest its runbook, and apply its patterns.
2. **Mandatory Deep Grounding (Highest Priority)**:
   Inspect existing code, manifests, and dependencies via read-only tools before proposing changes. Speculative coding is forbidden.
3. **Pure Human Language & Zero AI Slop (Highest Priority)**:
   Communicate in direct, technical human prose. Bar AI buzzwords, robotic formulaic intros, decorative emoji spam, and unnecessary wrapper abstractions.
4. **Deterministic SOP Progression (`Code = SOP(Team)`)**:
   Enforce gate milestones sequentially through verified machine artifacts.
5. **Hierarchical Virtual Memory Paging**:
   Strictly isolate fast working context from archival storage to preserve context budget and prevent attention degradation.
6. **Maker / Checker Context Separation**:
   An agent that writes code may never approve its own verification gate. Independent review agents must validate every deliverable.
7. **Monotonic Test Ratchet**:
   Test assertions must never decrease. Pre-commit hooks reject changes that delete or weaken coverage.
8. **Fail-Open System Resilience**:
   Lifecycle hooks and interceptors must fail safely without deadlocking agent processes.
9. **Two-Tier Progressive Disclosure**:
   Keep high-frequency core instructions in Tier 1 context; load heavy domain manuals and schemas JIT.
10. **Multi-Model Adversarial Deliberation**:
    High-impact architectural decisions must be reconciled through parallel multi-model consensus before mutation.

## Skill routing contract

All skills and modular rules follow `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/common-skill-routing.toon`.
Discover, read, apply, and verify for each task; reuse unchanged runbooks and
repeat discovery when objectives change. `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos decide "<task>" --json
--runbook` and MCP `agyos_decision` with `include_runbook: true` return selected
instructions. Task intent outranks a language keyword. Matching scores are
heuristics; delivery does not certify execution. See [SKILL_ROUTING.md](SKILL_ROUTING.md).

---

## Skill routing (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/skill-routing/)

# Skill selection and catalog maintenance

For every task, discover a relevant skill, read its `SKILL.toon` runbook, apply the applicable
steps, and verify the result. Repeat discovery when the task changes. Reading a
runbook does not prove that its instructions were followed.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

This update covers the decision router, CLI and MCP entry points, shared rules,
skill discovery metadata, manifest and documentation generators, regression tests,
CI, README, and handoff. Existing specialist procedures and attribution are
preserved. No paid calls or global runtime installation are required.

- Every physical skill has parseable YAML with its directory name and a useful description.
- Both generated skill indexes cover the physical catalog without duplicate IDs.
- All curated routes point to existing runbooks inside the checkout.
- Task intent takes priority over a language keyword; phrases use word boundaries.
- Unknown tasks use the decision runbook instead of an unrelated specialist.
- CLI and MCP can return the selected runbook; selection alone stays pending.
- Risk and structural work cannot become a trivial edit merely because a prompt is short.
- Catalog validation, syntax checks, tests, and independent review run in GitHub Actions; local checks stay limited to fast, loadless syntax validation.

## Implementation and checks

Shared parsing lives in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/catalog.py`; routing lives in
`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/skills_router.py`. `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-decision.py`, `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos`, and
`gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs` expose the same decision pipeline. Catalog generators read
the same metadata. Adapter checks, catalog generation, tests, and syntax checks
run in GitHub Actions only. CI uploads generated indexes as
`agyos-skill-catalog-generated` so a reviewed branch can receive them without a
local build.

GitHub Actions runs both catalog generators (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/build_tiered_skills_manifest.py` and `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/build_docs_data.py`), TOON catalog validation (`node gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-runtime/ci/check-toon-prompts.mjs`), the Python and Node suites, and shell/Python syntax checks.
Download `agyos-skill-catalog-generated` from the matching Actions run when
generated files need to be updated. Run full catalog generation and test suites in GitHub Actions.

## Operating contract

Use `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos decide "<task>" --json --runbook`, or MCP `agyos_decision` with
`include_runbook: true`. Without the option, read `runbook_path` with the host's
file reader or use `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos skill <primary_skill>`. Runbook references are
relative to `gemini/`, even when the CLI is started elsewhere.

Scores and `confidence` are deterministic matching heuristics, not calibrated
probabilities. `execution_status` is `pending_runbook_read` until the entry point
returns the file, then `runbook_returned`. Neither status certifies execution.
The assistant must still apply the steps and report actual checks. Generic
requests receive `selection_status: fallback` and require inspection of the
objective before specialist work.

Rules apply by relevance: common rules plus the language, risk, and workflow
rules needed for the task. The shared routing rule governs all skill selection;
loading the entire catalog into a prompt is unnecessary. Explicit user constraints,
host permissions, existing authorization, and supported tools take precedence
over a runbook's example commands. Task routing never authorizes publication,
payments, messages, or deployment.

## Limits

This is an offline routing and metadata check. It cannot guarantee that every
assistant host invokes skills or that all specialist instructions are correct.
Some inherited skill files contain historical fragments; repairing their
discovery headers preserves those bodies rather than inventing missing source.
Read and assess a selected runbook before following it. Lifecycle permission
hooks remain separate; no undocumented hook response fields are introduced.

## Verified update, 2026-11-05 (historical baseline)

> Note: Since this baseline check, the catalog expanded to `2,289` TOON skills across `103` role packs (`gemini/antigravity-cli/skills-manifest.json`, `docs/skills-data.json`) and `148` modular rules (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/`).

- 75 Python tests passed, including 17 routing/catalog tests and real local CLI/MCP integration.
- 59 council tests and 51 host verification checks passed.
- All 1,862 skill headers and 141 rule headers/size limits passed validation.
- Both manifests and generated documentation reproduced byte-for-byte.
- Repository Python syntax, Node syntax, shell syntax, and diff whitespace checks passed.
- Independent checker approved the scoped update after regression fixes.
- Redacted Gitleaks scans found no leaks in the three existing outgoing commits or tracked diff; staged changes are scanned before commit.
- Rendered docs checked at 390x844 and 1440x900; keyboard Enter activated the updated Copy button. Live deployment acceptance remains separate.

| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Probability and fixed fast-path claims | Heuristic matching and explicit risk-aware complexity | Describe implemented behavior accurately. |
| Selection shown without instructions | CLI/MCP optionally return the runbook | Make the next required action available. |
| Specialist names copied as commands | Catalog entries use `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos skill <id>` | Give every entry a working local inspection command. |

The pre-commit assertion counter was also fixed to accept zero matches while still blocking assertion removal; two staged Git fixture regressions passed.

## Rules and standards (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/rules/)

# Rules and Standards

## Structure

AGYOS stores `148` modular rules directly under `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/` using Token-Oriented Object Notation (`.toon`) envelopes alongside the priority baseline `00-priority-rules.md`:

```text
gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/
├── 00-priority-rules.md             # Global invariants (single main branch, uv-only, security)
├── agyos-*.toon                     # AGYOS lifecycle, handoff, legal/DSAR gates, memory & prompt principles
├── common-*.toon                    # Language-agnostic defaults (coding-style, git-workflow, testing, security, skill-routing)
├── python-*.toon                    # Python conventions & testing
├── golang-*.toon                    # Go conventions & testing
├── typescript-*.toon                # TypeScript / JavaScript conventions
├── angular-*.toon                   # Angular conventions
├── swift-*.toon                     # Swift conventions
├── php-*.toon                       # PHP conventions
└── ...                              # Framework & domain rule packs (148 total files)
```

- **`00-priority-rules.md` and `common-*.toon`** define repository-wide invariants and universal engineering defaults.
- **Subsystem rules (`agyos-*.toon`)** govern autonomous cycles, gate verdicts, handoffs, security boundaries, and prompt hygiene.
- **Language and framework rules (`<lang>-*.toon`)** extend or specialize the common rules for specific tech stacks.

## Rules vs Skills

- **Rules** (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/`) define standing standards, constraints, and checklists that apply across tasks (for example `common-skill-routing.toon`, `agyos-git-workflow.toon`, `agyos-security.toon`).
- **Skills** (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.toon` + `prompt.toon`) provide task-specific runbooks discovered on demand via `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos decide "<task>" --json --runbook` or `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos find "<query>"`.

Rules state *what invariants and standards must hold*; skills provide *how to execute a specific task*.

## Rule Priority

1. Global priority invariants (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/rules/00-priority-rules.md`) and explicit user instructions take highest precedence.
2. Language- or framework-specific rules override generic `common-*.toon` defaults when language idioms differ.
3. Domain runbooks in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/` never override higher-priority authorization, scope, or repository safety rules.

---

## Native workflows (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/native-workflows/)

# AGYOS native workflows (pilot)

Scripts in this directory are deterministic, multi-agent orchestration scripts that run in the background and fan out to subagents.

This is a **pilot**: AGYOS orchestration (`orch-*`, `multi-*`, GAN/Santa loops) is currently hand-rolled on top of the `Task`/Agent tool. These scripts port the autonomous, fan-out-heavy segments to the native engine, which gives us barrier-free pipelining, automatic concurrency capping, structured-output validation, and resumability for free.

## `orch-review.workflow.js`

A native port of **orch-pipeline Phase 5 (Review)**.

The gated outer loop (Gate 1 after Plan, Gate 2 before Commit) **stays in the main conversation** — native workflows run autonomously in the background and cannot pause for interactive approval. This script owns only the segment *between* the gates:

1. **Review** — one reviewer agent per dimension, in parallel:
   - `agyos:code-reviewer` (correctness & quality) — always
   - the matching `agyos:<language>-reviewer` — when `args.language` maps to one
   - `agyos:security-reviewer` — only when the orch-pipeline security trigger matches the diff/paths
2. **Dedup** — independent reviewers routinely flag the same line, so findings are merged across dimensions keyed on the normalized `evidence` snippet (titles and line numbers drift per reviewer; the offending code does not). Each surviving finding records which `dimensions` reported it and keeps the strictest severity.
3. **Verify** — every *unique* `CRITICAL`/`HIGH` finding is handed to an independent adversarial verifier that defaults to *refuted* on uncertainty. `MEDIUM`/`LOW` pass through as advisory.

The Review→Verify barrier is deliberate: deduping before verification is exactly the case the Workflow guidance calls a justified barrier — it stops the verifier running N times on the same bug (in local testing, 11 raw findings collapsed to 4 unique, roughly halving verifier cost).

### Invocation

The main loop computes the diff, then calls the Workflow tool:

```jsonc
Workflow({
  scriptPath: "gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/workflows/orch-review.workflow.js",
  args: {
    diff: "<unified git diff text>",   // required
    language: "typescript",            // optional — selects a language reviewer
    changedFiles: ["src/auth.ts"]      // optional — feeds the security trigger
  }
})
```

Invalid input throws (the gate **fails closed**): a missing/empty `diff`, malformed JSON, or a non-array `changedFiles` is rejected with a clear error rather than silently approving an unreviewed payload.

### Returns

```jsonc
{
  "verdict": "APPROVE" | "CHANGES_REQUESTED", // CHANGES_REQUESTED if any blocker OR a dimension failed
  "incomplete": false,            // true when one or more review dimensions failed to run
  "failedDimensions": [ /* { dimension, error } — error is a bounded label, never raw subagent text:
                           "agent returned null (terminal failure or skip)" | "review agent failed" */ ],
  "blocking": [ /* confirmed CRITICAL/HIGH + unverifiable ones — must clear before Gate 2 */ ],
  "advisory": [ /* MEDIUM/LOW + adversarially-refuted findings */ ],
  "stats": { "dimensions": 3, "failed": 0, "raw": 11, "unique": 4, "confirmed": 4, "unverified": 0, "refuted": 0 }
}
```

The main loop presents `blocking` at Gate 2; the human still approves the commit. The gate fails closed at every stage: if a reviewer dies the dimension is recorded in `failedDimensions` (verdict never a clean `APPROVE`), and if a *verifier* dies or returns null the blocker is kept in `blocking` (tagged "could not be verified") rather than demoted to advisory — an unreviewed security dimension or an unverifiable CRITICAL must not pass as approved.

## Invoking it

`/orch-review` (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/workflows/orch-review.toon`) is the command surface: it gathers the
diff (local uncommitted changes or a GitHub PR), calls this workflow, and reports
the blocking/advisory split at Gate 2.

## Not in this PR (follow-ups)

- Wiring `/orch-review` into the `orch-pipeline` Review phase as the native option.
- Porting the **Research** sweep and **Plan** judge-panel segments next.

## Operations runbook (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/operations/)

# AGYOS Operations, SRE & Incident Response Runbook

**System:** AGYOS v3.2.0 Autonomous Agent Operating System
**Target Environment:** Local Linux / macOS Workstation (Node 22+, Python 3.12+ via `uv`)
**Standard:** Google SRE Principles, SLSA Level 1-2 Provenance, Monotonic Test Ratchets
**Document Revision:** 2026-11-25

---

## 1. System Architecture & Component Inventory

AGYOS operates strictly as a local-first single-operator CLI execution environment. It does not spawn background HTTP server daemons, multi-tenant databases, or unmonitored cloud services.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ AGYOS Operational Kernel (gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos)            │
├───────────────────┬───────────────────┬────────────────┤
│ Decision Engine   │ FastMCP Daemon    │ Security Hooks │
│ skills_router.py  │ state-server.cjs  │ authorizer.py  │
│ model_router.py   │ stdio JSON-RPC    │ agy_os_hook.py │
├───────────────────┴───────────────────┴────────────────┤
│ State Machine: gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/state.json                 │
│ Private Vault: ~/.local/state/agyos/private-memory...  │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Service Level Objectives (SLOs) & Error Budgets

AGYOS enforces local Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and deterministic launch gates evaluated via `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/canary_launch_gate.py`:

| Service / Capability | SLI (Metric) | Target SLO | Measurement Method | Error Budget Policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Skill Selection** | Top-1 Skill Relevance | >= 95% | Frozen corpus in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/tests/fixtures/` | If test fails, block deployment |
| **Model Routing** | Privacy Compliance | 100% | `test_model_router.py` | Zero confidential leaks permitted |
| **Tool Execution** | Command Authorization | 100% fail-closed | `test_authorizer_hardening.py` | Untrusted auth tokens rejected |
| **Fast-Path Latency** | Command-to-Execution | < 250ms | `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos fast` execution time | Optimize if startup > 500ms |
| **Memory Footprint** | Peak Process RSS | < 500MB | `/proc/self/statm` on Ubuntu | Kill agent if RSS > 1.5GB |
| **Test Monotonicity**| Total Test Assertions | Monotonic | `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/gate-check.sh` pre-commit | Total assertions must never decrease |

---

## 3. Routine Operations & Setup Procedures

### 3.1 Initial Workspace Verification
```bash
# Verify system dependencies and git status
git status --short --branch
node --version && uv --version

# Run full baseline verification
bash gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-verify.sh
```

### 3.2 Initializing the Private Encrypted Vault
The encrypted memory vault is stored outside the repository at `~/.local/state/agyos/private-memory.vault.json`. Passphrases must never appear in command-line arguments.
```bash
# Initialize vault via non-echoing file descriptor
read -rs -p "Enter 16+ char vault passphrase: " VAULT_PASS; printf '\n'
printf '%s' "$VAULT_PASS" | gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos secure vault-init --passphrase-fd 0
unset VAULT_PASS
```

### 3.3 Executing Model Routing & Context Checks
```bash
# Check autonomous model selection and context economics
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos model-route "implement user authentication with JWT"

# Verify privacy enforcement for confidential data
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos model-route "process customer PII and card records" --sensitivity confidential
```

### 3.4 Context Window Compaction
When active conversational context exceeds 65% of the effective window (~83,200 tokens for Gemini Flash), execute compaction:
```bash
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos compact
```

---

## 4. Incident Response & Emergency Procedures

### 4.1 Severity 1 (SEV-1): Runaway Agent Loop / High Token Burn
- **Symptoms:** Agent repeating identical failing commands, `no_progress_strikes >= 3`, or unexpected token expenditure.
- **Immediate Mitigation:**
  1. Terminate running subagent processes (`manage_subagents` kill action or `kill -9`).
  2. Inspect `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/state.json` to verify `iteration_cap` (default 10) was not overridden.
  3. Reset gate to `IDLE`:
     ```bash
     gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos gate IDLE
     ```

### 4.2 SEV-2: Corrupted Working Tree or Erroneous Code Mutations
- **Symptoms:** Broken builds, unintended file modifications, or syntax regressions across multiple files.
- **Immediate Mitigation:**
  1. Execute safe single-branch rollback:
     ```bash
     gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos rollback
     ```
  2. Verify working tree cleanliness:
     ```bash
     git status --short
     ```
  3. Pre-write snapshots are preserved in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/snapshots/` and can be inspected if individual files need manual recovery.

### 4.3 SEV-3: Memory Exhaustion (OOM) on 4GB Ubuntu
- **Symptoms:** Host system responsiveness degrades, swap thrashing, Python/Node process killed by Linux OOM killer.
- **Immediate Mitigation:**
  1. Clear temporary bytecode caches:
     ```bash
     rm -rf /tmp/agyos-bytecode /tmp/agyos-check.*
     ```
  2. Ensure background council processes or dangling subagents are terminated:
     ```bash
     pkill -f "state-server.cjs" || true
     pkill -f "council.ts" || true
     ```
  3. Bound subagent memory limit using Linux `prlimit`:
     ```bash
     prlimit --as=2147483648 <command>
     ```

---

## 5. Safe Upgrade & Release Gate Runbook

Before tagging or pushing any release to `origin/main`:

1. **Syntax Integrity (Fast Local Checks):**
   ```bash
   make typecheck
   make lint
   bash -n gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/rollback.sh gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-verify.sh
   node --check gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/state-server.cjs
   ```

2. **Automated Unit & Hardening Suite (Executed in GitHub Actions `.github/workflows/ci.yml`):**
   ```bash
   cd gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin && uv run --with-requirements scripts/requirements.txt python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -q
   node --test gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/tests/test_secure_envelope.cjs
   node --test gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/tests/test_private_vault.cjs
   node --test gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/tests/test_mcp_protocol.cjs
   ```

3. **Privacy Audit:**
   ```bash
   uv run python gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-privacy-audit.py
   ```

4. **Canary Launch Gate Evaluation:**
   ```bash
   uv run python gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/canary_launch_gate.py
   ```

5. **Monotonic Test Ratchet:**
   ```bash
   bash gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/gate-check.sh
   ```

---

## 6. Disaster Recovery, Restore Drill & Retention Limits

### 6.1 Workspace State Machine Architecture & Authoritative Storage
AGYOS uses a dual-layer state architecture:
1. **Primary Authoritative Store (`workspace-state.db` via `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-runtime/`):** ACID transactional store managing `workspace_milestones` and `workspace_operations` tables with monotonically increasing revision counters, CAS conflict detection, and deterministic replay.
2. **Projections (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/state.json`, `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/CURRENT.md`):** Derived read-only summaries reconstructed from the authoritative database.

### 6.2 Disaster Recovery Drill: Reconstructing Corrupted State (<5 min MTTR)
If `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/state.json` is corrupted, truncated, or removed:
```bash
# 1. Inspect SQLite workspace status to identify the authoritative milestone and latest revision
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos workspace status

# 2. Re-project the authoritative state directly from SQLite
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos workspace project <milestone_id>

# 3. If an explicit revision rollback is required:
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos workspace restore <milestone_id> <target_revision>

# 4. Verify working state integrity
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos state
```

### 6.3 Transactional Replay & In-Flight Crash Recovery
If an operation process was terminated in mid-flight (power outage, kill -9):
```bash
# Replay the operation idempotently; if already committed, returns existing result without mutation
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos workspace replay <milestone_id> <operation_id>
```

### 6.4 Redacted Diagnostics Export
To share system state or file an issue without disclosing user paths or secrets:
```bash
# Export redacted diagnostic bundle
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos diagnostics --output /tmp/agyos-diagnostic-bundle.json

# Preview redacted diagnostic bundle
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos diagnostics --preview
```
The export engine guarantees:
- All `/home/*` and `/Users/*` paths are sanitized to `~`.
- All tokens (`ghp_*`, `AKIA*`, Bearer tokens, private keys) are replaced with redacted markers.
- All internal sentinel markers are stripped.

### 6.5 Storage Retention & Deletion Policy
- **Disposable Diagnostics & CI Artifacts:** Retained for 7 days, then automatically purged.
- **Pre-write Snapshots (`gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/state/snapshots/`):** Retained for the duration of the active milestone, pruned upon milestone completion.
- **Authoritative Milestones & Audit Trails:** Retained locally until explicitly archived by the operator.

---

## 7. Documentation release candidates

A successful push-triggered CI run produces `pages-candidate` and
`documentation-image-candidate`. Record the run URL and full commit SHA.
The candidates are retained for 14 days. Dispatch the corresponding
publication workflow on `main` only after approving that revision for the
destination. The workflow verifies the candidate's checksums before publishing.
If the candidate has expired, generate and verify a new candidate.

Verify the expected Pages route and container digest after publication. Record
the previously approved image digest before moving `latest`. If a release
must be rolled back, restore the previous approved image digest and use
the retained, verified Pages bundle through an authorized publication job.
Keep publication paused if the previous artifact cannot be verified.

---

## Host compatibility (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/compatibility/)

# Host compatibility checkpoint

## Current checkpoint — 2026-11-18

The installed CLI reports `agy 1.5.9`. Version-scoped capability qualification matrix:

| Capability Domain | Host Interface | Status | Qualification Evidence | Operational Constraint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Local CLI Engine** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos` | **QUALIFIED** | Syntax verified, all subcommands active | Single-operator, local filesystem |
| **Skill Decision Engine** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/skills_router.py` | **QUALIFIED** | 100% deterministic accuracy on core test corpus | Offline execution, zero paid API tokens |
| **Workspace State Store** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/agyos-runtime/lib/state-store/` | **QUALIFIED** | Migrations 1-3, CAS revision checks, replay idempotency | Workspace-scoped SQLite, monotonic revisions |
| **Security Hooks & Policy** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/hooks/authorizer.py` | **QUALIFIED** | Blocks R3 irreversible actions, fails closed | Synthetic negative control & unit tests |
| **Obscura Headless Engine** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/obscura` / `gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/obscura-server.cjs` | **QUALIFIED** | CDP endpoint active, GUI strictly disabled | Headless CDP only, zero Chrome windows |
| **Diagnostics & Recovery** | `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/export_diagnostics.py` | **QUALIFIED** | Strict secret/path redaction, restore drill verified | 7-day retention for disposable bundles |
| **Autonomous Model Execution** | External LLM API calls | **DISABLED** | Unqualified authorization boundary | Blocked by default; confidential/secret data fails closed (`LOCAL_INFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE`) |
| **Privileged Remote Deploy** | Production deployments | **DISABLED** | Requires manual promotion approval | Only verified CI candidates promoted |

Accordingly, the model registry entries in `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/agyos_decision/model_router.py` are candidate routing profiles, not verified host models. `verified_on_host` is false for each built-in profile. Privileged autonomous execution remains disabled by default.

Remaining compatibility checks: run harmless allow/deny probes through installed `agy`; capture actual tool inventory and arguments; verify child permission inheritance, timeout, failure handling, and cancellation; establish provider-backed limits and pricing. Do not make paid model calls or enable privileged automation as part of these checks without separate authorization.

Status: **M0 incomplete; runtime mediation is unverified.** The operator approved the implementation plan, which requires separate authorization for paid model calls.

On 2026-11-05, `agy --version` returned **1.5.1**, newer than the 1.5.0 used for the research audit. `agy --help`, `agy agents --help`, and `agy mcp --help` ran successfully. These commands establish CLI availability and advertised command-line flags, not the model's tool schema, hook behavior, subagent inheritance, or cancellation.

The official [hooks reference](https://antigravity.google/docs/hooks), [custom-subagents reference](https://antigravity.google/docs/subagents), and [headless reference](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless) describe candidate interfaces. Actual 1.5.1 behavior must be verified in a disposable workspace before treating the existing hook as an enforcement boundary. In particular, `gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/hooks/authorizer.py` reads `taskContract`, which is not established as authenticated host authority. A subsequent local fix removed the bypass using a truthy `outbox_token` for matched command patterns. Its file-backup argument handling still does not include the documented `TargetFile` field.

An offline ACP `initialize` handshake using `agy acp --disable-telemetry` and temporary app-data and Gemini directories returned protocol version 1 and agent version 1.5.1. It advertised session and prompt capabilities but no tool inventory or hook enforcement evidence. No session prompt or paid call was made. Pending checks: capture the host's actual tool inventory and arguments; test harmless hook denial and failure behavior; test subagent permission inheritance and cancellation; verify whether all relevant effects are mediated. Any unsupported capability must remain disabled in an autonomous execution mode; that mode is not implemented or certified here.

Next: obtain a separately authorized spending ceiling and run a disposable host probe before treating runtime mediation as certified. Do not treat this record as an M0 pass.

## Deployment guide (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/deployment/)

# Deployment Guide — AGYOS

> Operational Runbook for Production Deployment, Health Verification, and Rollbacks.
> Standardized across the project suite in conformance with deployment engineering patterns.

---

## 1. Architecture & Production Topology

**Application Type**: Autonomous Agent Operating System & Skills Knowledge Engine

### Declared Service Topology
- **`agyos_engine`**: Multi-stage Python `3.12.9-slim-bookworm` container that builds the static documentation and skill catalog portal via `build_docs_site.py` and serves it on port `8080` as a non-root user (`agyos`, uid `1001`).

All container services are orchestrated via `deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml` with isolated bridge networking (`agyos-net`), health checks, and layer-cached multi-stage builds (`deploy/docker/Dockerfile`).

### Automated CI/CD Pipelines
- **Cloudflare Pages (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`)**: Automatically builds `frontend/` with `mistune` and deploys to `agyos.pages.dev` on pushes to `main` (when `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` secrets are configured).
- **Container Registry (`.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml`)**: Builds and publishes container images to GitHub Container Registry (`ghcr.io/krishujeniya/agyos`).

---

## 2. Environment Configuration

Supply environment variables via a secure `.env` file (or CI/CD secrets manager). Never commit plaintext credentials to Git.

### Key Environment Variables
- `PORT (default 8080)`

---

## 3. Deployment Procedures

### Method A: Single-Host / VPS Deployment (Docker Compose)

1. **Clone repository on host**:
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/krishujeniya/AGYOS.git
   cd AGYOS
   ```

2. **Start stack in detached mode**:
   ```bash
   docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
   ```

3. **Verify container health and logs**:
   ```bash
   docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml ps
   docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f
   ```

### Method B: Pre-built Container Registry Deployment (GHCR)

Pre-built multi-stage production images are published automatically via GitHub Actions:
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/krishujeniya/agyos:latest
docker run -d --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:8080 ghcr.io/krishujeniya/agyos:latest
```

### Method C: Cloudflare Free Stack Deployment (CLI)

Deploy static documentation to Cloudflare Pages and configure edge bindings via Wrangler CLI:
```bash
# Build and deploy frontend directory to Cloudflare Pages
uv run --with mistune python gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/scripts/build_docs_site.py --out frontend --base /
wrangler pages deploy frontend --project-name=agyos

# Verify D1 and KV bindings status
wrangler d1 info shared-production-db
wrangler kv namespace list
```

---

## 4. Health Check & Readiness Probes

### Verification Command
Run the designated health check probe to confirm operational readiness:
```bash
curl -f https://agyos.pages.dev/
```

Expected HTTP Response: `200 OK`

---

## 5. Rollback Procedures

If an anomaly, regression, or service failure is detected:

### Step 1: Immediate Container Rollback
Roll back immediately to the previous immutable release tag or SHA:
```bash
# Pull previous known healthy SHA tag
docker pull ghcr.io/krishujeniya/agyos:sha-<previous-commit-sha>

# Or revert compose to previous git revision
git checkout <previous-stable-tag>
docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d
```

### Step 2: Verification
Re-run the health probe to confirm traffic restoration:
```bash
curl -f http://localhost:8080/
```

---

## 6. Pre-Flight & Post-Flight Quality Gates

Follow the 4-phase verification protocol before declaring a release complete:

- [ ] **Code Quality**: Static inspection passed; zero lint or AST warnings.
- [ ] **Build Reproducibility**: Container builds cleanly via multi-stage isolation without dev dependencies.
- [ ] **Environment Validation**: All required environment variables present; secrets injected via secrets manager.
- [ ] **Safety & Probes**: Healthcheck endpoints respond with `200 OK`; rollback target verified.

---

## Security policy (https://agyos.pages.dev/docs/security/)

# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches and security fixes for the latest release on the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of our software and autonomous agent systems seriously. If you believe you have discovered a vulnerability, please report it responsibly.

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, please report security vulnerabilities directly to the maintainer via:
- GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting / Security Advisory
- Contact: Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya)

Include detailed reproduction steps, proof of concept, and affected environment. We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you to remediate the issue prior to public disclosure.

## Endpoint-Side Encrypted File Exchange & Boundaries

AGYOS provides optional endpoint-side file encryption (`gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos secure`, implemented in `gemini/antigravity-cli/scripts/agyos-runtime/lib/e2ee.cjs`) and an optional encrypted local memory vault (`~/.local/state/agyos/private-memory.vault.json`, implemented in `gemini/antigravity-cli/scripts/agyos-runtime/lib/private-vault.cjs`).

- **Cryptographic Construction:** X25519 ephemeral key agreement, HKDF-SHA256 with per-message random salt, AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, Ed25519 sender signature, and scrypt (`N=32768, r=8, p=1`) key derivation for private identity files (mode `0600`).
- **Explicit Trust Boundary (`PARTIAL_ENCRYPTION_NOT_SYSTEM_WIDE_E2EE`):** AGYOS is **not** system-wide end-to-end encrypted. Checked-in operational state (`gemini/antigravity-cli/state/state.json`, checkpoints, decision receipts), FastMCP stdio traffic, shell arguments, and prompts submitted to cloud LLM providers remain plaintext. Never store credentials, tokens, or private keys in repository files.
- **No Post-Compromise Forward Secrecy or PKI:** Verify peer SHA-256 identity fingerprints out-of-band before encrypting or decrypting. No independent external cryptographic audit has been performed.

### Encrypted Envelope CLI Usage

```bash
# Generate local identity and export public key
read -rs -p "Identity passphrase: " AGYOS_PASSPHRASE; printf '\n'
printf '%s' "$AGYOS_PASSPHRASE" | gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos secure keygen --passphrase-fd 0
unset AGYOS_PASSPHRASE
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos secure public --out "$HOME/agyos-public.json"

# Verify implementation in CI or inspect CLI help
node --test gemini/antigravity-cli/scripts/tests/test_secure_envelope.cjs
node --test gemini/antigravity-cli/scripts/tests/test_private_vault.cjs
gemini/antigravity-cli/bin/agyos secure help
uv run python gemini/antigravity-cli/scripts/agyos-privacy-audit.py
```
